dialogues.speaker: Feiming
dialogues.text: A jug of wine in the mountains — enough to soothe a weary soul. The brew here is truly fine. If not for business, I'd gladly drown in it...

dialogues.speaker: Feiming
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, hello. You're the spitting image of one of the dear friends of my family's second young master. What a delightful coincidence!

dialogues.speaker: Feiming
dialogues.text: I hail from Liyue's Feiyun Commerce Guild. It's the finest guild in the region, and I specialize in silk and textiles.

dialogues.speaker: Feiming
dialogues.text: Natlan's fabrics are renowned for their mysterious, arcane properties. That's why the guild sent me here to see if we could come to some sort of agreement.

dialogues.speaker: Feiming
dialogues.text: If the opportunity presents itself, do visit us in Liyue. I guarantee you won't be disappointed.
